    • isSkipCheck

      public boolean isSkipCheck()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      Determines if a check (a REST call) should be performed to validate that the given plan name is actually valid or if we should just assume that it is. You'll get a slightly faster response when creating a PbcsPlanType because you'll skip a REST call.
      Specified by:
      isSkipCheck in interface PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      Returns:
      true if the validity check should be skipped, false otherwise.

    • isQueryDimensions

      public boolean isQueryDimensions()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      If true, an explicit dimension plan type will be created and the AIF endpoint will be queried to get the list of dimensions to populate. This option is off by default. "Regular" users may not have permissions to query the endpoint, so this method will generally only work for users with Service Administrator privileges and above. If set to true, the value of PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration.getExplicitDimensions() will be ignored. Note that attribute dimensions are not returned from this [undocumented] REST endpoint, so if you need attribute dimensions then you should still populate them through PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration.getExplicitAttributeDimensions().
      Specified by:
      isQueryDimensions in interface PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      Returns:
      the value for query dimensions

    • isValidateDimensions

      public boolean isValidateDimensions()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      If explicit dimensions are defined, then each one will be validated by issuing a "get member" call using the dimension name as the dimension and root member. This does not ensure that a list of dimensions is complete, just that all the defined dimensions are valid.
      Specified by:
      isValidateDimensions in interface PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      Returns:
      true to perform dimension validation

    • getExplicitDimensions

      public List<String> getExplicitDimensions()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      The list of explicit dimensions that are being set for the plan. It's not required to set dimensions to use a plan type, but you must set them if you want dimension resolution without a dimension name to work such as in PbcsPlanType.getMember(String).
      Specified by:
      getExplicitDimensions in interface PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      Returns:
      the list of explicit (known) dimensions for the plan, empty collection if none are being set

    • getExplicitAttributeDimensions

      public List<String> getExplicitAttributeDimensions()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      You can specify a list of dimensions that are explicitly attribute dimensions, and as such their PbcsDimension.getDimensionType() will return PbcsMemberType.ATTRIBUTE. Being able to differentiate attribute dimensions is useful for certain grid parsing operations that may need to know which dimension axes are optional. Not all attribute dimensions have to be specified.
      Specified by:
      getExplicitAttributeDimensions in interface PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      Returns:
      the list of dimension names that are attribute dimensions

    • isIgnoreAliases

      public boolean isIgnoreAliases()
      Description copied from interface: PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      Controls whether aliases are omitted when PbcsExplicitDimensionsPlanType.cache() pre-populates the configured member resolver. This can prevent ambiguous entries when an outline, such as an FCCS Currency dimension, contains duplicate aliases. Member names are always cached.
      Specified by:
      isIgnoreAliases in interface PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
      Returns:
      true to omit aliases from bulk member caching
